name: map-hypothesis-arguments
description: Turn any hypothesis, however fringe, into an argument map instead of a verdict: five parallel lenses (consensus, skeptic, frontier, historian, experimental design), a synthesis, and a verifier that calibrates confidence and may abstain. Use for frontier science, unusual business models and stigmatized verticals. Triggers: "/map-hypothesis-arguments <hypothesis>", "run the swarm on <X>", "build an argument map for <X>", "for and against <X>", "steelman both sides".
